title: Bug - Vaporize must run the Windows executable emitted by SwiftPM
description: Vaporize's swift-win run path used the extensionless Swift product name after a successful build. SwiftPM emits a .exe on Windows, so CommonProcess correctly rejected the nonexistent extensionless path.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize adds .exe only when resolving a source-built CLI executable on Windows.
The Windows CUJ regression is stored under the platform test surface and references this Bead.
Vaporize build swift-win succeeds for Translate.
Vaporize run swift-win executes Translate --help without callers spelling .exe.
risks: Adding the suffix outside the platform-specific artifact-resolution boundary could corrupt product identity or non-Windows paths.
